name: debate-site-visual-qa-tools
description: The headless browser and the scorer behind site/scripts/visual-qa.mjs. A separate package on purpose: these are hundreds of megabytes and need the network, and site/package.json has to stay installable offline and in seconds for lint, test and build (docs/process/working-agreements.md, CI budget). Installed once by the operator; see 'Pre-launch visual QA' in site/README.md.
